name: CPLIST Custom post listing
author: Maulik Makwana

sections.description:
Custom Post Listing allows you to generate and manage shortcodes that display posts from any post type with flexible options. You can control post type selection, number of posts, columns, layout. This plugin allows you to create shortcodes to display posts from any post type, with customizable display options, columns, and post limits.

The plugin also supports:
– Custom post type selection
– Display field options (image, title, button etc.)
– Column layout customization
– AJAX-based loading for faster user experience

Perfect for creating blog grids, portfolio listings, or WooCommerce product displays without writing code.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress Plugins page.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Custom Post Listing in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create a new shortcode and configure your display settings.
  5. Copy and paste the generated shortcode (e.g. [cplist_ajax_post_list id="123"]) into any page or post.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin with custom post types?

Yes, you can select any registered post type (including custom ones).

Does it support AJAX loading?

Yes! The plugin uses AJAX to load posts dynamically for better performance.

Can I customize the display layout?

Yes, you can customize columns, colors, and visibility of fields like title, image, date, etc.
